verdict.rationale: Omnara publishes its own API reference: an API section in the docs, such as the authentication page, and a probed OpenAPI spec at docs.omnara.com/openapi.json. A spec like this could drive an interactive reference, but the pack never shows a try-it console or runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.omnara.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Omnara provides an **API**, **Typescript SDK**, and **CLI** to interact with Omnara
Send either key as a bearer token.
